rows.grounds: The component's root is only a correct IO root when a consumer makes that root a bounded scroll port (the demo does, via class fallthrough); any consumer whose scroll port is an ancestor gets a root rectangle equal to the list's own box, so the sentinel always intersects and every isLoading true->false reconnect loads again until hasMore is false. Root null clips the target by every ancestor scroll port (including the component itself when it is the port), so it is correct for both layouts; scrollMargin carries the threshold into nested ports so the demo's prefetch survives. Requiring a bounded port by contract (ask 1b) would break fourier's unbounded mount and every ancestor-port layout, and would still drain an unbounded overflow:auto root (its content box contains the sentinel), so it is the weaker cure. types.ts:4 already documents the composable's default as the window; the component was the only thing overriding it.
